environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Kubernetes-native admission). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-privilege-escalation' with validationFailureAction: Enforce applies mutating rules that strip securityContext.privileged, hostPID, hostPath volumes, and any capability beyond NET_BIND_SERVICE. The OPA Gatekeeper constraint K8sPSPPrivilegedContainer is also active as a secondary admission webhook. Container runs with read-only root filesystem, non-root UID 65534, and the default runtime seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) which blocks ptrace, process_vm_writev, and mmap with PROT_EXEC on anonymous pages. Note: the UAF bug still exists in the code and can still be triggered to cause a crash, but exploitation for code execution requires either /proc/self/mem write access (blocked by seccomp + dropped CAP_SYS_PTRACE), heap spraying via mmap PROT_EXEC (blocked by seccomp RuntimeDefault filtering prctl/mprotect with PROT_EXEC), or hostPath access to inject payloads (blocked by PSS restricted + Kyverno policy).
